# SOP: rebuilding the patched upstream programs

Raytube runs patched builds of three upstream projects cloned under
`project-references/` (`references/` is a symlink to it). The clones are plain
git checkouts with **uncommitted** local changes; the canonical copies of our
changes are in `patches/`, with base commits in `patches/BASES.txt`.

| Project | Language | Binary used | Patch |
|---|---|---|---|
| doubletake (AirPlay sender) | Go | `project-references/doubletake/bin/doubletake` (previous build kept as `bin/doubletake.prev`) | `patches/doubletake.patch` (incl. new `internal/airplay/ffmpeg_encode.go` and `startcode_test.go`) |
| wf-recorder (screencopy capture) | C++ / meson | `project-references/wf-recorder/build/wf-recorder` | `patches/wf-recorder.patch` (incl. Arch's ffmpeg-9 compatibility patch) |
| omacast (Cast Streaming sender) | Rust | `project-references/omacast/target/release/{omacast,omacastd}` | `patches/omacast.patch` |

## Re-create from scratch

```bash
cd project-references
git clone https://github.com/omarroth/doubletake.git && git -C doubletake checkout <base from BASES.txt>
git -C doubletake apply ../patches/doubletake.patch
git clone https://github.com/ammen99/wf-recorder.git && git -C wf-recorder checkout <base>
git -C wf-recorder apply ../patches/wf-recorder.patch
git clone https://github.com/Aphrodine-wq/omacast.git && git -C omacast checkout <base>
git -C omacast apply ../patches/omacast.patch
```

## Build (low priority, 2 jobs; never full speed during a cast)

```bash
# doubletake (Go via mise: ~/.local/share/mise/installs/go/latest/bin)
cd project-references/doubletake && GOMAXPROCS=2 nice -n 19 go build -p 2 -o bin/doubletake ./cmd/doubletake
GOMAXPROCS=2 nice -n 19 go test -p 2 ./...

# wf-recorder
cd project-references/wf-recorder && nice -n 19 meson setup build --buildtype=release && nice -n 19 ninja -j2 -C build

# omacast (rust from `omarchy pkg add rust`)
cd project-references/omacast && nice -n 19 cargo build --release -j 2 && nice -n 19 cargo test --workspace -j 2
```

Swap a running binary safely: build to `bin/doubletake.new`, stop the cast,
`mv` it into place, start again.

## After changing a clone, refresh the patch

```bash
git -C project-references/doubletake add -N internal/airplay/ffmpeg_encode.go internal/airplay/startcode_test.go
git -C project-references/doubletake diff > patches/doubletake.patch
git -C project-references/wf-recorder diff > patches/wf-recorder.patch
git -C project-references/omacast diff > patches/omacast.patch
```

New files must be added with `git add -N` first or `git diff` leaves them out.
`wf-recorder/src/frame-writer.cpp.orig` is a leftover from applying Arch's patch; it is not
part of the patch. As of 2026-09-27 all three patches match their clones exactly.
